title: Vibrant Shattering Egyptian Vegetables Bake
description: A flavorful and nutritious Egyptian-inspired dish featuring shattering vegetables, tangy gherkin relish, and aromatic spices. Perfect for a monsoon evening.
instructions: Cut the eggplants, onion, bell peppers, and zucchini into bite-sized pieces.
Place the vegetables in a large bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Transfer the vegetables to a large baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
While the vegetables are baking, prepare the gherkin relish by mixing it with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and top with the gherkin relish.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
